llms:
Formula Central 3 by 3 differences of the calibrated field give gradient g and Hessian H in the orthogonal pixel basis. The smallest eigenpair (lambda, n) defines q = -(g dot n) / lambda * n / spacing. A valid interior cell is a ridge when lambda < 0, -lambda >= minimumCurvature, center >= minimumValue and each q component is in [-0.5, 0.5). Half-cell ties select the larger column/row; equal eigenvalues choose the column normal. Strength is max(0, -lambda) at every valid stencil. Borders and stencils with missing or nonfinite samples write zero to all outputs. Geographic/Web Mercator ground scales are row-local tangent approximations, not a covariant Hessian or a material-LCS test.
